2011 MAZDA2
PRODUCT SUMMARY
The 2011 MAZDA2 offers subcompact customers a captivating compact design, a fun to drive experience and excellent value
for money.
The following equipment is standard as indicated. Each series includes the standard equipment of the previous series, except
where additions / exceptions are noted:

l Electric Power Assist (EPAS) steering system
l Front disc & rear drum brakes
l Anti-Lock Brake System with EBD and Brake-Assist
l Dynamic Stability Control (DSC)
l Traction Control System (TCS)
